input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal is automatic but fully meets the preferred position: each renewal term is twelve months (§ 8.2), Customer may opt out on thirty days' written notice (§ 8.2), Vendor must give a renewal reminder at least sixty days beforehand — with Customer's opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed (§ 8.2), and renewal uplift is capped at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent (§ 8.3). No multi-year automatic renewal or long notice window, so no walk-away concern. No redline required.
